description: This file defines the AuditListener class, which uses JPA annotations to automatically update audit information (such as timestamps) on entities implementing the Auditable interface during persistence events.

classes.name: AuditListener
classes.description: A JPA entity listener that updates audit timestamps before persisting or updating entities.

methods.name: onSaveOrUpdate
methods.description: Method triggered before saving or updating an entity; updates the audit timestamps accordingly.
